PositionHistory.Title: Pega Business Architect
PositionHistory.Description: Client: Department of Veterans Affairs, Austin, TX Feb 2013-March 2014 Role: Pega Business Architect The Non VA Medical Care provides essential health care services to Veterans when these services are not available at VA facilities or when services cannot be economically provided due to geographical inaccessibility or emergency. During a period of exponential growth, claims processing has remained primarily manual in nature. The legacy systems do not provide the needed system enhancements that could have automated monitoring of funds, review of claims for fraud, waste, and abuse, and the review of supporting clinical information justifying Non VA care. The new system will centralize the management and servicing of the three main activities required to pay a claim: Eligibility and Enrollment, Referral/Authorization and Claim Processing. The Health Care Claims Processing (HCP) application in PRPC leverages industry-standard frameworks such as Health Care Industry Foundation and Claims Repair. Responsibilities:  Work with business stakeholders from Chief Business Office (CBO) and the VA Financial Services Center (FSC) to clarify business requirements and scope for HCPS and create a high level Application Profile (AP) for initial review and sizing purposes.  Developed excellent understanding of industry standard health care concepts such as X12 transactions and layouts for different claim form types such as Institutional, Professional, Dental (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277), HIPAA edits, Business edits, Eligibility and Enrollment, Referrals and Authorization, Member and Provider validations, clinical code sets, Configuration modules such as Benefits Administration, Payment Methodologies, claims administration.  Coordinated the effort on classifying requirements into major components such as: Claims Intake, Pre-Adjudication, Adjudication, Post-Adjudication/Payments.  Responsible for leading the effort on translating Business Use Cases (BUCs) into Pega Atomic Use Cases (AUCs) in preparation for DCO sessions in elaboration phase.  Conducted client enablement sessions in conjunction with Pegasystems consultants to walk through PRPC capabilities.  Conducted Gap Analysis to compare business requirements with available PRPC health care frameworks (Health Care Industry Foundation, Claims Repair, and Claims Workstation) to leverage out of the box capability as much as possible and identify components that need to be extended.  Supplement requirements captured in Pega DCO suite with detailed business process flows and activity flow diagrams to facilitate easy understanding of intended functionality for the development team.  Created click thru prototypes using draft flows and UI rules in PRPC in preparation for the elaboration phase.  Facilitated Prep and Review DCO sessions leveraging the AUCs and prototypes to facilitate effective feedback solicitation and to concur upon requirements.  Identified applicable work types, interfaces, correspondence, skill matrix and reporting requirements.  Conduct biweekly play back sessions to demo functionality built to date in construction phase to ensure that application development is in line with business requirements.  Responsible for conducting end of sprint and increment walk thru sessions with project leadership team and stakeholders. Accelerator), PRPC Frameworks - Health Care Industry Foundation and Claims Repair, HP Quality Environment:Pega PRPC v6.2 (including DCO tools such as Application Profiler/Application

PositionHistory.Title: Pega Business Analyst
PositionHistory.Description: Center, MS Project 2007, MS Visio 2010, Rational ClearQuest, Rational Requisite Pro Client: Kaiser Permanente, Washington DC Dec 2011-Jan 2013 Role: Pega Business Analyst Kaiser Permanente is a leading consumer health services and health insurance provider in North America. They are committed to assisting physicians and hospitals to their members to improve the extraordinary quality of healthcare. The company serves different individual, corporate and municipal customers hence it needed ease in day-to-day reporting. The company wanted us to develop a data warehouse which would facilitate ease in reporting. Responsibilities:  Modeled Business requirements into workflows to depict various scenarios of system to request RFI and RFP responses from major vendors.  Gathered legacy system requirements by shadowing Customer Service Representatives (CSRs), Customer Relationship Representatives (CRRs), preparing questionnaires, to identify limitations in the current system and GAPS in the proposed system.  Created an enterprise workflow application based on CRUD rules for Customer Data that would allow for future integration of data infrastructure across various business areas into a single UI.  Prepared logical data model in the form of Business Context diagram to include various entities and attributes in order to facilitate the design of Data model in the form of ER Diagrams. Studied current information structures and data models of the current databases to better understand the design of target data source.  Performed custom data conversions and developed custom software for risk management applications including general claims, vehicle accident and administrative tracking. Performed all data field mappings.  Planning and conducting DCO Elaboration sessions with target SME's.  Used Rational Rose to model the process using UML to create behavioral and structural diagrams.  Used Rational Clear Quest to track required changes and Rational Clear Case to maintain different versions of the project documentation  Involved in integration of various Customer Data Sources and provided Data Mapping from various sources like CCD, LPCD, DCD into the target centralized customer data source. Designed and developed Use Cases, Activity Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, OOAD using UML and Business Process Modeling.  Intricately involved in Business Process Flow development, Business Process Modeling, and ad hoc Analysis. Performed detailed comparative analysis of response to RFPs of vendors and Graphically Represented the recommended solutions in PowerPoint to Senior Management.  Prepared Business Context Diagram, Use Case diagrams and corresponding Activity Diagrams using Rational Rose to depict the workflows to be incorporated into the development of Pega Business Process Management (BPM) tool.  Actively involved in validating the requirements and applying the agile framework throughout the SDLC.  Conducted Requirements walk - through with Business Team to ensure that all their needs are met and gathered sign off on requirements for SOX compliance after the requirements were base lined.  Prepared and maintain Business Rules Spreadsheets (BRS) identifying Rules, Triggers and corresponding data fields from Legacy to target CRM application.  Followed a methodical Change Management Process and documented any Change Requests into Clear Case for any changes in the requirements after the requirements were base lined.  Perform unit test, system test and integration test for implementation. Worked very closely with the Test team to Test all iterations during the Testing Phase and documented all the defects.  Developing test plan for integration test. Prepared Test Cases based on base-lined Requirements Document, prepared Requirements Traceability Matrix and provided Performance Testing Requirements.  Developed detailed Testing Strategy for the entire UNICA campaigns and developed various test cases. Facilitated the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with Pega System Administrators and Business Users, documented any issues or defects and eventually got sign off from the right parties.  Prepared training materials in the form of User manuals by preparing step-by-step guide to all screen flows in CMS.  Assisted in development of User Interfaces and prepared screenshots to get business's buy-in on the requirements. Environment: Oracle, Toad, PL SQL, SQL server, Share Point, Quality Center, MS Office, MS Visio, PERADIAM, XCELYS, SQL, Cognos Reporting.

PositionHistory.Title: Business Analyst
PositionHistory.Description: Client: Gentiva Health Services, Virginia Beach, VAAug 2010-Dec 2011 Role: Business Analyst The project was to develop a Provider Desktop module for the EHR (Electronic Health Record System) with the objective to improve productivity and patient care. It serves as a central dashboard for providers to access crucial information such as Patient appointments, Clinical results, Messages, Electronic lab orders and Patient encounter notes anytime anywhere. The project was implemented securing patient privacy and health information conforming to HIPAA standards and guidelines. Responsibilities:  Interacted closely with the Business users along with the administration and management to gather business requirements and analyze the functionalities to be incorporated into the system  Worked on HIPAA 5010 transaction requirements and analyzed and tested HIPAA ANSI X12 formats including 270/271, 276/277, 834, 835, 837, 997, and NSF formats for interfaces and images to third part vendor applications  Analyzed processes in medical coding and transition from ICD 9 - ICD 10.  Worked with BA and UAT tasks.  Attended demo sessions to understand existing system functionalities  Arranged interviews with all the stakeholders to review and understand the gathered business requirements  Coordinated with system architects and developers to convert business requirements into system requirements  Conducted meetings to document Change Requests for new requirements  Analyzed business requirements and segregated them into Use Cases.  Created Use case diagrams and documented Use case specifications  Maintained various versions of the documents generated during the project using Rational Clear Case  Was responsible for creating and updating project schedule and managing resources and timeline using MS Project  Prepared the project status reports and represented the BA team in the PMO meetings  Participated in UAT along with the development & testing teams  Gathered requirements from collection, claims, Billing, and insurance appeal departments  Working with the business and various technology departments, and acting as a liaison between the underwriters and application developers to provide production support for the National Pricing Solution web based application  Interacting with National Pricing Staff (Underwriting, Actuarial & Sales/AM) on daily basis with regards to how the NPS application functions, troubleshooting incidents/issues for Users and completing defect and enhancement requests on daily basis  Performing system administrator duties i.e. adding/removing users to system Participating in UAT and working  This project also provides the Base component of the MMIS, which receives and processes prior authorizations, referrals, claims, and remittance advices for medical and dental services.  The project also manages provider enrollment for all Medicaid providers along with the Medicaid Member. This includes the files and data conversion and migration of all application functionality from the legacy MMIS system to the client-server application (Health PAS system).  Maintaining and modifying training documents  Extracting data from databases and preparing reports for auditing/SOX compliance purposes  Traveling throughout regional offices to provide support and training to end users as an SME (Subject Matter Expert) in Claims processing & management, mentored & trained entry levels Environment: Microsoft Word, Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Oracle 10g/11g

PositionHistory.Title: Business Analyst
PositionHistory.Description: Client: Premier Inc, Philadelphia, PA July 2007 - Aug 2008 Role: Business Analyst Premier provides its clients with clinically-based solutions for addressing over use, misuse and under use of prescription drugs, and the consequences of such inappropriate utilization on healthcare costs. The system involved is a complete solution for the clinics and hospitals as it can manage customer data like case history, doctors' visiting hours, and other staff time tables including records of the treatment and procedures done on a patient. Through clinical management, Premier engages members, their physicians and pharmacists, in making better, more cost-effective use of prescription drugs. The project was to enroll new clients in this clinical management system base and allow them to customize it as per their requirements. Responsibilities: * Worked closely with Premier's Clients including Doctors, Assistants, Pharmacists, Technicians and Process Analysts to understand the Business Process, gather Business Requirements, identified process specifications and developed the Business Requirement Document. * Prepared Technical Design Documents & Functional Requirement Specifications in accordance with BRD. * Reverse Engineered and analyzed the existing system and developed GAP analysis document in accordance with the Business rules to implement the system in most optimized way. * Defined program and project goals, objectives, products, services, constraints, assumptions, risks and facilitated processes by working with the project team, sponsor, and stakeholders to baseline the scope of the work. * Implemented the full project lifecycle phases including requirements gatherings, development and quality assurance. * Designed and developed UML Use Case Diagrams, Class Diagrams, Activity Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, Data Flow Diagrams and Collaboration diagrams using MS Visio. * Conducted Joint Application Development (JAD) sessions with development and other IT teams to define the requirements and supported developers in the use of Change Management and Change Control tools including Rational Requisite Pro and Clear Quest. * Used Query Optimization to identify at the best suitable Query Plans for the system. * Assisted Data Conversion team with Data Mapping and Data Extracting Strategies for data migration. * Interacted with release management team to sketch out the timelines & drafted estimation document. * Involved with the QA team to determine and develop test approaches and methods for unit testing, integration and functional testing, load, and usability testing according to application complexity and test requirement. * Involved in creating an on-line Help Document and tutorials for the system. Environment: Windows XP/2000, Oracle9i, SQL, MS-Project, MS-Office, MS Visio, Mercury Test Director, Rational Rose, UML
